message.reasoning:
We need to produce a JUnit 4 test file ValuedEnumTest.java that comprehensively tests all methods in ValuedEnum. Methods: constructor (protected), getEnum(Class, int) static, getValue(), compareTo(Object), toString(). Also need to test behavior when enumClass null, when value not found returns null, etc.

We need a concrete subclass for testing, similar to JavaVersionEnum example. Create TestEnum extends ValuedEnum with static instances.

Test cases:

- testGetValue: ensure getValue returns correct int.
- testGetEnumByValueFound: use getEnum(TestEnum.class, value) returns correct enum instance.
- testGetEnumByValueNotFound: returns null.
- testGetEnumNullClass: expect IllegalArgumentException.
- testCompareTo: compare different values, expect negative/positive/zero.
- testCompareToWithDifferentClass: compare to other valued enum different subclass? compareTo expects ValuedEnum cast, but may cause ClassCastException if not same type? Actually compareTo casts to ValuedEnum, not checking class, so if other is different subclass but also ValuedEnum, it will compare values. Should test that works.
- testCompareToNull: expect NullPointerException.
- testToString: ensure format matches short class name without package, name and value.
- testToStringCaching: call toString twice, ensure same instance (iToString) but we cannot access private field; we can verify that second call returns same string (equals) and maybe ensure no change after modifications.

Also test that compareTo respects numeric ordering.

Need to import JUnit 4 annotations: @Test, @Before maybe.

Since ValuedEnum is abstract, we need subclass defined within test file.

Also need to handle reflection for getEnum: internal uses Enum.getEnumList(enumClass). Need to have Enum class from org.apache.commons.lang.enums.Enum. We assume it's present. The test can rely on it.

We'll write test file:

package org.apache.commons.lang.enums;

import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.*;

public class ValuedEnumTest { ... }

Define static inner class SampleEnum extends ValuedEnum with static final instances.

Make sure to include a private constructor calling super.

Test methods.

Edge Cases: test compareTo with same value returns 0.

Test compareTo with other type that is not ValuedEnum (e.g., String) expecting ClassCastException.
